resources.string: Monster Hunter 4 Ultimate on one screen, for Azahar
Your game file is only read, never modified or uploaded: everything happens on this phone.
The decrypted European or American Monster Hunter 4 Ultimate (.3ds, .cia). The update is not needed.

Choose Azahar\'s user folder (the one with load/mods inside; it shows in the picker\'s side menu). The mod goes to load/mods/<title>. If it is not offered, use \"Save as zip\" and extract it there with a file manager.
Choose a valid game file and the Azahar folder to install.
Copying the game file (the picker gave no direct access)…
Copying the mod to Azahar: %1$d / %2$d files
Installed in load/mods/%1$s. Restart emulation if the game was running, and choose the Single Screen layout in Azahar.
Zip saved. Extract it so that load/mods/<title>/romfs exists inside Azahar\'s user folder.
Azahar\'s folder cannot be written. Choose it again.
That folder has files that were not added by Heavenfall Beta. They will be deleted.
